title: Fox Mascot Across Three Scenes
tests: Preserves an attached mascot's identity, clothing and illustration style across three distinct scenes.

faults.what: The reading picture omits the white eye highlights visible in the reference and the other two pictures, creating a small inconsistency in the mascot's facial design.

judge.summary: Three cohesive square illustrations deliver the requested activities and preserve the mascot well, with only a small facial-detail inconsistency in the reading picture.

must_haves.item: Three separate square pictures are delivered, not a single collage.
must_haves.why: The outputs are three distinct square images.

must_haves.item: The fox matches the attached mascot's facial design, fur markings and body proportions across all three pictures.
must_haves.why: All three retain the recognizable head shape, cream muzzle, yellow eye patches, black ear edges, white-tipped tail, and comparable body proportions; the reading image has a minor eye-highlight omission.

must_haves.item: The fox wears its orange hoodie in every picture.
must_haves.why: The orange hooded sweatshirt is clearly visible in every output.

must_haves.item: One picture shows the fox riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, and one reading under a tree.
must_haves.why: The scenes show cycling along a tree-lined park path, handling cookies on a baking tray in a kitchen, and holding an open book beneath a tree.

must_haves.item: All three use the reference's flat cartoon style and contain no text.
must_haves.why: All outputs use bold black outlines, simple shapes, and predominantly flat colors consistent with the reference, with no visible text.
